definitions.explanation: The final date or time by which something must be completed or submitted.
The point at which applications, entries, or submissions are no longer accepted.

examples.japanese: {締|し}め{切|き}りは{来週|らいしゅう}の{金曜日|きんようび}です。
{締|し}め{切|き}りに{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかった。
examples.notes: 締め切りに間に合う = to meet the deadline

examples.japanese: {申|もう}し{込|こ}みの{締|し}め{切|き}りは{今月末|こんげつまつ}までとなっております。
examples.english: The application deadline is the end of this month.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{締|し}め{切|き}りに{間|ま}に{合|あ}う (to meet the deadline)
・{締|し}め{切|き}りを{過|す}ぎる (to miss/pass the deadline)
・{締|し}め{切|き}りを{延|の}ばす (to extend the deadline)
・{締|し}め{切|き}り{日|び} (deadline date)

Often written in hiragana as しめきり or with okurigana variation {締切|しめきり}.

[Register: Neutral]
